name: ProSound X1 Wireless Earbuds
description: Premium wireless earbuds with 30-hour battery life, Bluetooth 5.3, and IPX5 water resistance. Built for Pakistan's climate and daily commute demands.
review_summary: Exceptional sound clarity, 30-hour total battery life, and a connection that held across 2km of city commute without a single dropout. Best in class under Rs. 5,000.

name: 2-Year Extended Warranty
bump_description: Full replacement or repair coverage for 2 years. One-time fee, zero hassle. Covers all manufacturing defects and connectivity issues.

name: Wireless Charging Dock Pro
description: 3-in-1 wireless charging dock. Charges phone, earbuds, and smartwatch simultaneously. Compatible with all Qi-enabled devices.
